div.div:
Durable user inbox and email intent; context pointers still require authorization.
ATTRIBUTES (NN required / ? nullable)
id: uuid [PK NN]
default gen_random_uuid()
recipient_user_id: uuid [FK NN]
event_id: uuid [FK ?]
kind: text [NN]
locale: text [NN]
deduplication_key: text [NN]
safe_payload: jsonb [NN]
read_at: timestamptz [?]
created_at: timestamptz [NN]
default CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
CONSTRAINTS
UQ1: (recipient_user_id, deduplication_key)
CK1: locale IN ('kk','ru','en')
CK2: jsonb_typeof(safe_payload) = 'object'
FOREIGN KEYS / UML ASSOCIATIONS
(recipient_user_id) -> app_user(id) [1 parent / 0..* children]
(event_id) -> event(id) [0..1 parent / 0..* children]
All FK deletes/updates: RESTRICT. See TX rules for cross-row guards.

div.div:
One logical delivery per channel with retry bookkeeping.
ATTRIBUTES (NN required / ? nullable)
id: uuid [PK NN]
default gen_random_uuid()
notification_id: uuid [FK NN]
channel: text [NN]
status: text [NN]
default 'pending'
attempt_count: integer [NN]
default 0
next_attempt_at: timestamptz [?]
provider_message_id: text [?]
sent_at: timestamptz [?]
last_error: text [?]
created_at: timestamptz [NN]
default CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
CONSTRAINTS
UQ1: (notification_id, channel)
CK1: channel IN ('email','in_app')
CK2: status IN ('pending','sent','failed')
CK3: attempt_count >= 0
CK4: status <> 'sent' OR sent_at IS NOT NULL
FOREIGN KEYS / UML ASSOCIATIONS
(notification_id) -> notification(id) [1 parent / 0..* children]
All FK deletes/updates: RESTRICT. See TX rules for cross-row guards.

div.div:
Durable job/event saved with business commit; leased for at-least-once delivery.
ATTRIBUTES (NN required / ? nullable)
id: uuid [PK NN]
default gen_random_uuid()
event_id: uuid [FK ?]
kind: text [NN]
deduplication_key: text [UQ NN]
payload: jsonb [NN]
status: text [NN]
default 'pending'
attempt_count: integer [NN]
default 0
available_at: timestamptz [NN]
default CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
lease_token: uuid [?]
lease_until: timestamptz [?]
completed_at: timestamptz [?]
last_error: text [?]
created_at: timestamptz [NN]
default CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
CONSTRAINTS
UQ1: (deduplication_key)
CK1: status IN ('pending','leased','done','dead')
CK2: attempt_count >= 0
CK3: jsonb_typeof(payload) = 'object'
CK4: (status = 'leased' AND lease_token IS NOT NULL AND lease_until IS NOT NULL) OR
(status <> 'leased' AND lease_token IS NULL AND lease_until IS NULL)
CK5: status <> 'done' OR completed_at IS NOT NULL
FOREIGN KEYS / UML ASSOCIATIONS
(event_id) -> event(id) [0..1 parent / 0..* children]
All FK deletes/updates: RESTRICT. See TX rules for cross-row guards.

div.div:
Request deduplication; commit result with business effect, never cache auth bypass.
ATTRIBUTES (NN required / ? nullable)
id: uuid [PK NN]
default gen_random_uuid()
actor_user_id: uuid [FK NN]
operation: text [NN]
request_key: text [NN]
request_hash: text [NN]
resource_type: text [NN]
resource_id: uuid [NN]
response_code: integer [NN]
expires_at: timestamptz [NN]
created_at: timestamptz [NN]
default CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
CONSTRAINTS
UQ1: (actor_user_id, operation, request_key)
CK1: response_code BETWEEN 200 AND 299
CK2: expires_at > created_at
FOREIGN KEYS / UML ASSOCIATIONS
(actor_user_id) -> app_user(id) [1 parent / 0..* children]
All FK deletes/updates: RESTRICT. See TX rules for cross-row guards.

div.div:
Append-only authorized activity timeline; immutable safe entity snapshots.
ATTRIBUTES (NN required / ? nullable)
id: uuid [PK NN]
default gen_random_uuid()
event_id: uuid [FK ?]
organization_id: uuid [FK ?]
actor_user_id: uuid [FK ?]
service_actor: text [?]
action: text [NN]
entity_type: text [NN]
entity_id: uuid [NN]
description: text [NN]
safe_change: jsonb [NN]
default '{}'::jsonb
correlation_id: uuid [NN]
created_at: timestamptz [NN]
default CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
CONSTRAINTS
CK1: num_nonnulls(actor_user_id,service_actor) = 1
CK2: jsonb_typeof(safe_change) = 'object'
CK3: event_id IS NULL OR organization_id IS NOT NULL
TRIGGER: reject UPDATE / DELETE (append-only).
FOREIGN KEYS / UML ASSOCIATIONS
(event_id, organization_id) -> event(id, organization_id) [0..1 parent / 0..* children]
(actor_user_id) -> app_user(id) [0..1 parent / 0..* children]
All FK deletes/updates: RESTRICT. See TX rules for cross-row guards.
